Seafeld Tour Guide

Famous Sights

- Seaside Promenade
A kilometer-long jetty built along the coast, beach on one side, shops on the other.
Enjoy the caress of the sea breeze and the whisper of the waves while you shop.

- Ploo Museum
Here, you can learn about local history and culture, in addition to visiting various specimens of local fish, shellfish, seaweed, and coral.

- Hilltop Park
Climb the winding mountain paths and stroll amidst the lush greenery. Here, you can view the coastline from high above, while the sunlight, flora, and ocean wash away your worries.

- Morningtide Cape
Take the town's tour bus to Sunset Cape. Not only does it boast magnificent cliffs and vast seas, but it also features the most beautiful sunrise in all of Planarcadia.

Featured Events

- Ploo Industries Half-Day Tour
As a veteran local enterprise, Ploo Industries opens its industrial park every weekend for tours.
Activities include: Visiting production workshops, learning about manufacturing techniques, a "Yellow Ducky Nibbles" free tasting session, and hands-on experiences with toys and daily necessities.
Additionally, the park features a company-operated store where visitors can purchase their favorite goods at factory prices.

- Seaside Carnival
Every weekend, a massive party kicks off on the sands west of the port.
The festivities include: A sea fishing competition, beach volleyball, a surfing contest, a bonfire night, and more.
During this period, the Smiles Society will also be hosting promotional events. Interested tourists are welcome to join in.

Local Delicacies

"Yellow Ducky Nibbles" Series
Includes famous products such as: "Seafeld Duck Head," "Ploo Chips," "Ploo Specials," etc.

All-Fish Feast
A local specialty feast featuring fish prepared in every way imaginable! Experience grilled, fried, pan-seared, cold-tossed, and boiled fish all in one go!

Rainbow Seaweed Dumpling
A traditional soup dumpling from the ploos, filled with a special seaweed stuffing. The skin is smooth and tender, while the filling is savory and juicy.

Hotels & Homestays

Isle of Waves Hotel
Features: Renovated from traditional ploo architecture, with rooms facing the ocean.
Services: Serves ploo specialty cuisine with traditional flavors.
Recommended for: Travelers seeking a unique ambiance and those who appreciate traditional culture.

Hotel of Happiness
Features: The largest hotel in the area, dedicated to providing the most meticulous and attentive service to the guests.
Services: Rooms and amenities sized appropriately for guests of all body types.
Recommended for: Customers who prioritize quality accommodation and service.

Oceanfront Residence
Features: A lively backpacker hostel known for its social vibe.
Activities: Small seaside bonfire mixers are held every weekend evening.
Recommended for: Solo travelers and visitors looking to make new friends.

From the field in the sea, the ploos' home, Seafeld City welcomes you!

May your time in Seafeld be unforgettable!
